product.title: Wagvive Orthopedic Comfort Bed
product.body_html:
Built for big dogs and tired joints.

An orthopedic egg-crate foam base spreads your dog's weight instead of collapsing under it, so hips, elbows and shoulders stay off the hard floor. Three raised bolsters give them something to rest a head against — the position most dogs settle into anyway. Sized properly for medium and large breeds, not scaled down to fit a cat.

  • Orthopedic egg-crate foam base that holds its shape
  • Three-sided bolster for head and neck support
  • Waterproof inner liner protects the foam from accidents
  • Non-slip base — stays put on wood and tile
  • Zip-off cover, machine washable
  • 41″ × 30″ — sized for large breeds, not scaled down

A good choice for senior dogs, heavy-set breeds, and any dog who has started avoiding hard floors.
